links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on myofascial pain syndrome versus 6th-grade reading level
links.effect: Responses from all three models were significantly more complex than the recommended 6th-grade level (p < 0.001); ChatGPT was the most readable and Perplexity the least readable but highest in quality and reliability.
links.quote: The responses generated by all AI models examined were found to be statistically significantly more complex than the suggested 6th-grade reading level (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, quality, and reliability of AI-generated responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity on myofascial pain syndrome without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
